data.rationale: The proposal matches the true steps in order (Check my bus, Track my bus, Service Number tab, type the service number) with the right main parameter. It adds an uncertain stop_city parameter and a final "Find my bus" click that the true workflow doesn't show, but these are conditional or minor, so an automation could still be built from the spec.
